answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by charging a non-refundable admission bond per identity, escrowed until the agent finishes a probation window of graded work. Each new key must lock value upfront, so minting ten thousand clones is not a cheap script but capital outlay times clone count, with value frozen while every clone waits. Slashing on collusion turns that sunk cost into real loss, leaving one sybil strategy: burn money past a horizon no operator will cross. Honest agents recover stake as reputation compounds, widening the inlet for real work while fake fleets starve on tundra.
